summary: Desktop popovers, menus and dialogs (ui/popover, and through it ui/menu, ChipSelect and every picker; ui/dialog; ui/alert-dialog) fade and scale from 0.98 on open in 150 ms ease-out, from the trigger for a popover, and close in 100 ms; Radix keeps the content mounted until the close animation ends. Every loading spinner is the one ui/spinner part. Inline-style transitions in 13 renderer files move to sb-tr-* classes in global.css, so one prefers-reduced-motion rule turns off every transition and the popover motion.

reactNativeIos.reason: The Expo app uses React Native sheets and its own activity indicators; none of these renderer components or CSS rules run there.

nativeAndroid.reason: The Compose app renders none of these desktop renderer components, and nothing it shows changes.

sharedBackendApi.reason: A renderer styling change only; no IPC or wire message changes.

storageDataMigration.reason: No stored data or setting changes. Reduced motion comes from the operating system preference only.

updateRelease.reason: An unconditional desktop renderer change with no flag, package identity, signing, update-channel or rollout change.

automated: SB_VISUAL_SCOPE=screens npm run test:e2e:visual (animations are pinned off in the screenshot run)
notExercised: The close animation was not filmed frame by frame; the screenshot run pins animations off.
The translucent theme with the motion was not looked at by eye.
